title: Struggling With Rhythm? Try my NEW Guitar App! :)
summary: In this JustinGuitar video, the instructor introduces his Lessons and Songs app as a companion to the beginner course, highlighting features designed to accelerate progress: a free built-in tuner, a large library of playalong tracks (over 600 songs), and a structured learning path with song recommendations aligned to Grade 1 and Grade 2 material. The core instructional emphasis is rhythm training through continuous backing tracks to prevent bad habits like stopping between chords, thereby improving both chord changes and timing. The video also shows practical app usage—how to navigate the learning path, use the practice assistant to plan practice duration, filter songs, and operate playback controls (swipe to slow, scrub forward/backward). It previews upcoming features (website-app syncing, simpler MIDI-based backing tracks, and more guidance) and reinforces the app’s credibility with positive reviews from App Store/Google Play. A practical takeaway is that the app is presented as a real-time practice partner that complements the course to reinforce rhythm, consistency, and progress tracking.
topics: no-stop backing track and rhythm discipline
